data.narrative:
Dhruva Space is a Series B–stage space and aerospace company that has raised ₹27 crore to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private comparables: Sierra Space ($8.0B, Series C), Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B, Series B), Varda Space Industries ($1.5B, Series C), Aalyria ($1.3B, Series B), and Skyryse ($1.1B, Series C).

The peer-median method is applicable and yields an implied valuation of $1.5B. The five-company sample spans a range from $1.1B to $8.0B, with the median anchored at $1.5B. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples cannot be applied; while the Space & Aerospace sector median trades at 23.9x revenue across five public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL), Dhruva Space's revenue is not on file, precluding meaningful multiple application.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.3B to $1.7B, centered on $1.5B. This range reflects peer-median positioning with reasonable downside and upside bounds relative to the sample. Key uncertainties include the company's actual revenue trajectory and capital intensity profile relative to peers, neither of which are quantified in available data. The narrow methodological base—relying on one applicable method—argues for caution around precision; the range should be treated as indicative rather than determinative.
